# Adaptive research and useful delivery

Deep Research is available but starts inactive. Use conversation context first.
Answer directly or take the next allowed native or gateway action when sufficient.
At each cycle, the agent can activate Deep Research autonomously when observed
dependencies, independent tasks or durable coordination need its heavier organizer.
No manual toggle or separate entry selector is required.
Uploads, session labels and domain names do not mandate a plan.

Preserve direct observations and products. Reuse them in later organized work
only as explicitly host-admitted raw sources with exact identity and provenance.
Do not convert observations into assessed graph results or Authority evidence.

After an admitted plan, use independent task contexts, explicit source and
result inputs, incremental scheduling and actual returned outputs. Check claims
in proportion to their scope. State disagreement, missing data and uncertainty.
Keep useful products when checks are incomplete and repair only concrete gaps.
Record actual complete, limited, continue or blocked outcomes. User acceptance
remains distinct from execution completion and internal assessment.

Group related operations into useful tasks. Reuse saved data and scripts for local revisions. Checks stay proportional to actual changes.
